goal: Route planning-department work by actual employee need: everyday creative/framework/image requests must enter fast creative mode, while source-backed competitor/trend work must require retrieval and citations, and formal review tasks still keep source facts, assumptions, and checklist separated.

acceptance_criteria.description: Planning short-video and image prompt requests match the dedicated planning content SOP scenario.
Planning content SOP payload requires creative brief, insight, video script, storyboard, voiceover, image prompt, source citations, and review checklist.
Router metadata identifies planning mixed-media requests as planning_creative_fast so everyday creative work answers first instead of blocking on historical company memory.
Planning framework requests are locked to framework-first output: table of contents, PPT slide titles, page details, and closed-loop structure.
Planning direct image/poster requests are hard-routed as direct media generation with no prompt-coaching loop and portrait poster defaults.
Planning competitor, trend, social-platform, and feedback requests require source-backed retrieval metadata before answer synthesis.
Planning short-video storyboard and brand-review requests match dedicated P0 scenarios.
Planning brand review is blocked before generation when review material, brand guideline, or usage context is missing.
